reason: I have never paid for an app and I'm not starting now; the kindergarten already teaches letters and numbers, and YouTube has plenty of free cartoons for that. I might download the free version, but I would not pay for PRO.
objection: Why pay every month for something the kindergarten and free YouTube videos already give my child?
would_change_my_mind: If the kindergarten teacher told me my child is behind and recommended this app specifically, I might try a month.
